description: This pattern targets optimizations in consensus protocols where implementations try to "save" existing log entries when applying a snapshot. The vulnerability occurs when the implementation assumes that if a local log extends beyond the snapshot index, the "tail" is valid. It fails to recognize that a snapshot from a higher term invalidates any local history (and subsequent tail) derived from a lower term at that same index.
trigger_condition: Snapshot installation occurs on a node containing uncommitted entries that extend beyond the snapshot index and belong to a divergent term.
